question: Should option 1 be implemented as a UNION of the two membership APIs or as a REPLACE of the cache by index_member_all?

the_two_apis_disagree_about_when_churn_h.consequence: neither API's churn calendar contains the other's, so REPLACE removes labels the cache had on days member_all considers a gap

recommendation: UNION. Replace leaves 0 day(s) below the floor in the worst case and 1 day(s) within 0.01 of it; the thinnest has 12 rows of margin on 2022-07-28, which is the same class of margin the decision sheet already rejected for the 'move yeslab_206 alone' pseudo-option (0-8 rows). Union is additive by construction and leaves zero days below the floor.
